card.name: Words before 'receive' or 'undergo' a treatment
card.fires_on: The word right after a patient group (patients, who, to, can) where the next word is likely 'receive', 'undergo' or 'be given' a treatment or procedure.

modes.label: Patients before 'who receive'
modes.description: The word 'patients' or 'who' after a population, setting up a clause about receiving a therapy.
modes.example: Fatal and other serious complications can occur in<< patients>> who receive allogeneic hematopo

modes.label: Scheduled to undergo
modes.description: A linking word after 'Scheduled' or similar, leading to undergoing a procedure.
modes.example: Dosage and Duration in Patients with Chronic Liver Disease Scheduled<< to>> Undergo a Procedure Platelet Count Recommended

modes.label: Adult patients in a surgical setting
modes.description: The word 'patients' after 'adult' in headings about surgery.
modes.example: Prophylaxis of Deep Vein Thrombosis and Pulmonary Embolism in Adult<< Patients>> Following Hip Replacement Surgery

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning receive, receiving or accept.
card.plain: It fires on the spot where the text is about to say patients receive or undergo a treatment.
